content:
Article name is descriptive in nature and based on current available information.

The **Visitor** is a creature in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

The creature is found in an overgrown chamber inside The Deep, where it lies on the ground. It does not move. It is surrounded by various bioluminescent plant life, and a lit Lantern. The Visitor faces a small tunnel in the wall opposite it, which conceals a flayed human corpse. Parts of the creature are similar to Strangler Plants and The Interloper.

- The Visitor is a static world object, and does not have any interaction with the player.
- Small transient black specks manifest in the air throughout its chamber, floating upward and fading away.
- The creature appears as part of a terrain tile in *Fallout: Wasteland Warfare* . [Ext 1] 

The Visitor appears in *Fallout 76* and *Fallout: Wasteland Warfare*.

The Visitor was added by Nathan Purkeypile as a nod to The Interloper at the Lucky Hole Mine, another creature he added. [Dev 1]

1. ↑ Nathan Purkeypile: *"Another one from Wastelanders. Fun fact: I just “snuck it in” (as much as you can when you’re Art Lead lol) because I wanted to do a whacky underground with a hidden Chinese base.🇨🇳 People liked it so much that it ended up getting made into a legit part of the quest lines.😄 [Images of The Deep] This is basically 76’s Blackreach in a lot of ways. 😄 I also did that creature you see there. It’s a nod to another creature I made and hid in 76, The Interloper. [Image of the Interloper]"*
 (*Fallout 76* developer statements/Locations; Nathan Purkeypile: The Deep & The Visitor, 2023 June 29)
